test_name: Verify Users Can Search and Filter Test Suites
description: This scenario tests the ability of users to search for specific test suites using the search box and apply filters to narrow down results.
steps: Navigate to the Test Suites page.
Verify the visibility of the search box with placeholder text.
Type a valid test suite name into the search box.
Press the 'Enter' key to initiate the search.
Observe the filtered results displayed in the test suites table.
Verify that the table updates with results matching the search query.
Click on the 'Show My Test Suites' filter option.
Verify the table updates and only displays test suites created by the logged-in user.
Clear the search box input and verify the table resets to display all test suites.
expected_results: Search results display test suites matching the query.
Filter updates the table to show only relevant test suites.
edge_cases: Empty search query results in no filtering applied.
Search query matches no test suites, displaying an empty table.
Filter option fails to update results due to backend issues.
User enters special characters in the search box.
Simultaneous use of filters and search query causes unexpected behavior.
data_requirements: Existing test suites in the database.
User with appropriate permissions to perform filters.
Test suite names that include special characters.
A list of test suites created by the logged-in user.
dependencies: Stable backend API for fetching test suite data.
Working filters functionality in the UI.
Correct implementation of the search feature.
performance_metrics: Time taken for search results to appear.
Time taken for filters to update the table.
accessibility_requirements: Search box must have an accessible label.
